verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never says whether Fellow uses meeting data to train AI models. It also documents no org-level training opt-out and does not mention SOC 2 or HIPAA. Retention policies (including zero-day retention), org-wide recording policies and a generic 'enterprise-grade security' claim are related controls, not the training-data disclosure, opt-out or compliance posture this story asks for.

support.subject: As an IT admin, the vendor documents whether meeting data trains AI models and gives my org an enforceable opt-out, alongside SOC 2 / HIPAA posture
